title: UUID Generator
description: Generate one or more cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers. Copy them for databases, APIs, or test data. Everything stays in your browser.
intro: Create unique version-4 UUIDs instantly. Choose how many you need and copy the list.
blurb: Generate random UUID v4 identifiers in your browser.
howItWorks: Set the number of UUIDs you want (1 to 50).
Click Generate. Each value is a standard version-4 UUID using the browser’s secure random source.
Copy the results. They are suitable for primary keys, correlation IDs, and test fixtures.
examples: Generate a single UUID for a new database record.
Create ten UUIDs for a batch of test users.
Produce identifiers for an API response fixture.

faq.a: Yes. They are randomly generated version-4 UUIDs, which is the most common type for new identifiers.
The generator uses the Web Crypto API (crypto.randomUUID or getRandomValues) when available, which is suitable for ordinary application IDs.

faq.q: Can the same UUID appear twice?
faq.a: The probability is vanishingly small for practical purposes. Version-4 UUIDs have 122 random bits.
